segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Leaving the whispering forest behind, Pip led you out onto a high stone ridge overlooking the valley.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Stretching across the canyon like the spine of a sleeping dragon was the Ancient Aqueduct—a massive, arched bridge of carved cobblestones. In summer, it must have carried mountain water to the village. Now, it was a solid highway of slick, blue-white ice suspended three hundred feet in the air.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Follow my lead, recruit,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip whispered, pulling his trench coat tight and dropping into a theatrical crouch.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Silent as an owl. Swift as an arctic shadow. Step precisely where I step.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip took three stealthy, exaggerated tiptoe steps out onto the ice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SQUEAK. SQUEAK. SQUEAK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His rubber boots made a noise like two wet balloons rubbing together.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Pip, your boots are squeaking,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you whisper.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: They are not squeaking,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip hissed back without turning around.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: They are providing audible confirmation of tactical friction—

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SNAP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A blinding beam of harsh, brilliant white light hit you both from the darkness above!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: High on the mountain crag, a clockwork searchlight tower had swiveled in your direction. The light was so bright you had to shield your eyes with your mitten.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A piercing brass steam-whistle shrieked into the freezing night air:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: WHOOOOO-EEEE-CLANG-CLANG!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A mechanical voice boomed from the watchtower horn, rattling the icicles under the bridge:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CURFEW PROTOCOL THIRTEEN INITIATED! UNAUTHORIZED SHADOWS ON HIGH SPAN! DEPLOY SEIZURE PATROLS!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Heavy wooden thuds echoed from both sides of the aqueduct. Marching onto the bridge from the north and south were squads of clockwork sentries, their crimson coats glowing under the searchlight beams, their brass bayonets raised and humming with purple electricity.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You're trapped in the middle of a frozen bridge three hundred feet above the valley floor.
